slot.brief: Order given alkyl halides by SN2 reactivity / leaving group ability and identify correct sequence.

stem: In acetone, methyl halides react separately with the same nucleophile by an $\text{S}_\text{N}2$ pathway. Which sequence gives increasing reaction rate?

verdicts.working: For S_N2 reactions, rate increases with leaving-group ability: I⁻ > Br⁻ > Cl⁻ > F⁻. Thus CH₃F < CH₃Cl < CH₃Br < CH₃I.

working:
$\text{I}^- > \text{Br}^- > \text{Cl}^- > \text{F}^-$ in leaving-group ability.\n$\therefore\quad \text{CH}_3\text{F} < \text{CH}_3\text{Cl} < \text{CH}_3\text{Br} < \text{CH}_3\text{I}$ in $\text{S}_\text{N}2$ rate.

Independent check: For S_N2 reactions, rate increases with leaving-group ability: I⁻ > Br⁻ > Cl⁻ > F⁻. Thus CH₃F < CH₃Cl < CH₃Br < CH₃I.
